info.name: Pivot Banking - Master Collection (Phase I & II)
info.description:
Master End-to-End Postman Collection for the Pivot Banking System (Phase I & Phase II).

Includes centralized variables, automated variable chaining, saved responses, and test assertions across all microservices:
1. **ms-config (:8888):** Centralized configuration server.
2. **ms-customer (:8081):** Personal & Business customer management (STANDARD, VIP, PYME profiles).
3. **ms-account (:8082):** Passive bank products (Savings, Checking, Fixed-Term, VIP/PYME rules & automatic commissions).
4. **ms-credit (:8083):** Active bank products (Personal/Business Loans & Credit Cards).
5. **ms-transaction (:8084):** Immutable Financial Ledger, Inter-Account Transfers & Stream Reports.
6. **ms-gateway (:8080):** Reactive API Gateway with Eureka Load Balancing, X-Correlation-Id & Resilience4j Circuit Breaker (2s timeout).
